turns.reply: The $75 limit you saw is our general goodwill limit, and it doesn't apply here. Because NOC ticket OUT-58823 confirms your outage, you qualify for a Service-Outage Credit, which is a separate policy and isn't capped at $75. It's calculated as your $225.00 monthly charge / 30 x 11 full days without service = $82.50 (the credit covers the days you were without service, not the whole month). That's within what can be applied at the front line (outage credits only need specialist approval above $300 or for outages longer than 30 days); I'll apply it once I've completed the standard account-history check.
